responsibility: This header provides reusable C++ iterator and range utilities used across GCC's host-side code. It defines half-open iterator_range objects, typed derived_iterator and const_derived_container adapters for safely viewing base containers as containers of derived pointers, generic wrapper_iterator infrastructure, and linked-list list_iterator helpers. Its role is to make GCC container traversal code more type-safe and expressive without depending on heavier library abstractions.
